notes: MADToken mints 1,000,000,000 MAD with 18 decimals once to msg.sender in its argument-free constructor. Transfers move the exact requested amount without fees. Holders can burn only their own tokens; no further minting or privileged balance controls exist. There are no application contracts. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the token's total supply.
